note: Bridger-Teton NF (Jackson RD) campground on the Hoback River, 13 mi E of Hoback Junction on US-189/191 (26 mi from Jackson). Sites can be tight and difficult for big rigs. --Claude
summary: FS page (Sep 21 2026): 8 first-come sites (no recreation.gov listing), $20 ($10 2nd vehicle), vault toilets, NO potable water (stored true), closes Sep 22 annually (2026: gate Sep 27). Waterfront: the Hoback is ~35 m wide on the north side and ~25 m wet on the east; the loop's sites sit behind a continuous willow/conifer band along the bank -> recommend riverfront -> riverview.
flags: WATERFRONT (recommend riverfront -> riverview): on zoom-19 imagery the river is ~35 m wide along the north side (river-size) and ~22-25 m wet (40 m between gravel bars) along the east side. The north loop road (~43.27050,-110.51600) runs ~25 m from the bank with a band of conifers and willow between; the east-side sites (~43.27010,-110.51510 and ~43.26985,-110.51500) are ~15-28 m from the bank through a continuous tree band. The best case is the open patch at the NW corner (~43.27055,-110.51640), ~15-20 m from the bank but with a shrub line along it; no site numbers could be placed (no site map on the FS page, no recreation.gov catalog). Stored evidence ('only scattered trees (no continuous screen)') does not match the zoom-19 view.
